say:1:1710244001:0.source_cn: 诸位请保持冷静！不要惊慌！

say:3:1710244002:1.text: Your Highness, I humbly apologize for my delayed arrival.
say:3:1710244002:1.source_cn: 殿下，属下来迟，请您恕罪。

say:4:1710244003:1.text: Commander Hendrik, cordon off the site immediately and maintain order!
say:4:1710244003:1.source_cn: 亨德里克卿，无需多礼。立即封锁现场！维持秩序！

say:6:1710244004:1.text: The Queen disregards Orion's orders and rushes to the steps, where the entrance to the Hall of Ancients should have been.
say:6:1710244004:1.source_cn: 王后没有理会奥利安的调度，而是快步冲到台阶前，那里本该...

say:8:1710244005:1.source_cn: 佩吉！奥利安！佩吉还在里面！

say:9:1710244006:1.text: Peggy and Cassadee... Both of them are still in there!
say:9:1710244006:1.source_cn: 她和科丝蒂都……她们都还在里面！

say:15:1710244010:1.text: Investigate the disappearance of the Hall of Ancients and rescue Princess Peggy.
say:15:1710244010:1.source_cn: 我命你立即展开调查，务必找回消失的圣古堂，救出佩吉公主。

say:17:1710244012:0.text: The Queen steps forward, extending her arms to sense the lingering magic in the air.
say:17:1710244012:0.source_cn: 王后走上前，伸出手，感知着空气中残留的魔力波动。

say:18:1710244013:0.text: There's raw, violent magic here... clearly the mark of a large-scale spell. A routine investigation won't suffice.
say:18:1710244013:0.source_cn: 这种魔力残留……粗暴又原始……这是大规模的魔法，不是常...

say:19:1710244014:1.text: Commander Hendrik, I believe in your competence and loyalty.
say:19:1710244014:1.source_cn: 亨德里克卿，我相信你的能力和忠诚。

say:20:1710244015:1.text: But we're facing something extraordinary, so we need the best help we can get.
say:20:1710244015:1.source_cn: 但面对超出常规认知的魔法，我们需要最顶尖的力量协助。

say:21:1710244016:0.text: Magister Merlin, would you be willing—
say:21:1710244016:0.male: Magister Merlin, would you be willing—
say:21:1710244016:0.female: Magister Merlin, would you be willing—

choice_prompt:22:1710244016.text: Magister Merlin, would you be willing—
choice_prompt:22:1710244016.male: Magister Merlin, would you be willing—
choice_prompt:22:1710244016.female: Magister Merlin, would you be willing—

say:23:1710244017:0.text: Your Majesty's suggestion is sound, but since this matter concerns the safety of a royal family member, perhaps...
say:23:1710244017:0.source_cn: 母后的提议确有道理，但事涉王室成员的安危，或许……

say:24:1710244018:0.text: We should let the chief court mage, Magister Cyran, take charge.
say:24:1710244018:0.source_cn: 该请首席宫廷魔法师，迪尔格雷卿来主持。

say:25:1710244019:1.text: I have full confidence in Cyran's abilities, but Merlin saved the world twenty years ago.
say:25:1710244019:1.source_cn: 我并非不信任迪尔格雷卿，但梅林阁下是20年前拯救世界的英雄。
say:25:1710244019:1.male: I have full confidence in Cyran's abilities, but Merlin saved the world twenty years ago.
say:25:1710244019:1.female: I have full confidence in Cyran's abilities, but Merlin saved the world twenty years ago.

say:26:1710244020:1.text: I believe his expertise will be crucial.
say:26:1710244020:1.source_cn: 作为当世闻名的大魔法师，<male>他</male><...
say:26:1710244020:1.male: I believe his expertise will be crucial.
say:26:1710244020:1.female: I believe her expertise will be crucial.

say:27:1710244021:1.text: Orion, this is a plea from me as a mother. Please, try to understand.
say:27:1710244021:1.source_cn: 奥利安，这是来自一位母亲的恳求，你能理解吗？

say:28:1710244022:1.text: ... Of course. Peggy's well-being comes first.
say:28:1710244022:1.source_cn: ……当然，母后，佩吉的安危最重要。

say:29:1710244023:1.text: Very well... Magister Merlin, would you be willing to assist with the investigation?
say:29:1710244023:1.source_cn: 既然如此……梅林阁下，您愿意协助此次调查吗？
say:29:1710244023:1.male: Very well... Magister Merlin, would you be willing to assist with the investigation?
say:29:1710244023:1.female: Very well... Magister Merlin, would you be willing to assist with the investigation?

choice_prompt:30:1710244023.text: Very well... Magister Merlin, would you be willing to assist with the investigation?
choice_prompt:30:1710244023.source_cn: 既然如此……梅林阁下，您愿意协助此次调查吗？
choice_prompt:30:1710244023.male: Very well... Magister Merlin, would you be willing to assist with the investigation?
choice_prompt:30:1710244023.female: Very well... Magister Merlin, would you be willing to assist with the investigation?

say:32:1710244025:1.text: Commander Hendrik and Magister Merlin, we entrust the investigation to both of you.
say:32:1710244025:1.source_cn: 那么，亨德里克卿，梅林阁下，就请二位共同负责此事。
say:32:1710244025:1.male: Commander Hendrik and Magister Merlin, we entrust the investigation to both of you.
say:32:1710244025:1.female: Commander Hendrik and Magister Merlin, we entrust the investigation to both of you.

say:33:1710244026:1.text: Commander Hendrik will direct the Royal Guard, while Magister Merlin will provide magical support.
say:33:1710244026:1.source_cn: 亨德里克卿负责守备军的调度与追查，梅林阁下负责魔法层面...
say:33:1710244026:1.male: Commander Hendrik will direct the Royal Guard, while Magister Merlin will provide magical support.
say:33:1710244026:1.female: Commander Hendrik will direct the Royal Guard, while Magister Merlin will provide magical support.

say:34:1710244027:1.text: I grant you full access to the Royal Guard's resources. Find the Hall of Ancients and bring Princess Peggy back!
say:34:1710244027:1.source_cn: 我允许你们动用守备军的一切资源，务必找回圣古堂和佩吉公主！

say:35:1710244028:1.text: I'll see to the arrangements at once, Your Highness.
say:35:1710244028:1.source_cn: 遵命，殿下。属下这就去安排。

say:37:1710244029:1.text: Magister, please come with me to the Royal Guard base to discuss our next steps.
say:37:1710244029:1.source_cn: 梅林阁下，也请随我一起前往守备军驻地，我们在那里商谈后...
say:37:1710244029:1.male: Magister, please come with me to the Royal Guard base to discuss our next steps.
say:37:1710244029:1.female: Magister, please come with me to the Royal Guard base to discuss our next steps.
